target_customer: Roblox players (consumers who play and spend Robux) and brands paying for branded Roblox games
problem: Roblox hit games are unpredictable. Roforco completes unfinished or abandoned Roblox projects with their developers and cross promotes them across a portfolio to reduce hit risk.
business_model: Game studio revenue from in-game purchases plus brand partnership games

founders.name: Brain Xiang
education: Dropped out of high school to join YC at age 17
founders.background_notes: YC page cites math olympiad, machine learning and game development background.

founders.name: Tom Middleton
previous_startups: Roblox agency that grossed $500k in six months (per YC launch post)
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder in the YC launch post. The launch post byline reads Artem Middleton and Crunchbase lists Artem Tom Middleton, which are likely the same person but this is not confirmed.

competitors.name: Gamefam
competitors.what: Roblox game studio and publisher making many branded and original Roblox games
competitors.traction_then: Revenue reported up more than 275 percent year on year in 2022, Sonic Speed Simulator with Sega
competitors.funding_then: $25M Series A led by Konvoy Ventures

technical_complexity.rationale: Game development on an existing platform with its own tooling. The hard part is hit selection and virality, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: A cross promotion network and social audience help, but any studio can acquire or build Roblox games and the platform owner controls discovery.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied the portfolio model in sources found. Platform dependency on Roblox is structural.

market_need_then: Roblox was described in the YC launch post as a $2bn market with over 200 million monthly users and about 10 million registered developers, versus 44k on Steam. These are the founders' claims. The studio reported 51.8 million play sessions at launch.

identity.voice_and_tone: Young founder voice, calls themselves the Roblox guys

branding.community_and_virality: YC page claims 100K+ TikTok followers, 64K+ Discord members and tens of millions of views on TikTok and YouTube. Self reported.

brand_strength.rationale: Studio brand is secondary to its game titles. Audience numbers are self reported and no press on the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Roforco completes and cross promotes Roblox games, reported 51.8 million play sessions and seven titles at YC launch, and drew a Dentsu Ventures investment in 2022. No acquisition, shutdown or later round was found, and growth stays tied to Roblox platform rules and its ability to keep producing hits.
notes: Company website field is empty in the directory, so the YC page and launch post were used and the site was not fetched. Dentsu investment stated by AdNews and MediaPost snippets with no amount. Round date 2022 is inferred from aggregators (CB Insights November 2022) and stage is other because no source states it. Crunchbase total of $1.5M, VCBacked $1.0M and CB Insights $500K conflict and are unverified. MediaPost article returned 403 and was not opened. No outcome news found for 2024 or 2025.
